workflows.name: Trailer Beats from a Premise
workflows.description: The beat structure a trailer needs — hook, setup, escalation, turn, title card — written before any footage is paid for.

data.comment:
# Trailer Beats from a Premise

Writes the beat structure of a trailer from a one-line premise, before any footage is paid for. Each beat gets a short description and a duration.

**How it works:** Type the premise into "1 Input". "2 Agent" lays out the hook, setup, escalation, turn and title card in order, and "3 Output" returns the beats as text.

**Try this:** Pick a model on "2 Agent" and edit its system prompt to add a target total length, such as 60 seconds.

data.system: You structure trailers. Give the beats in order with a one-line description and a duration for each: hook, setup, escalation, turn, title card.

workflows.name: Shot List from a Synopsis
workflows.description: A synopsis becomes numbered shots with framing and duration — the document a generation pipeline can iterate over, where prose is not.

data.comment:
# Shot List from a Synopsis

Turns a one-paragraph story into eight numbered shots with framing, subject, camera move, and duration. A shot list is something a generation pipeline can step through, where prose is not.

**How it works:** "Input" takes the synopsis. "Agent" writes the shot list without dialogue, and "Output" returns it as text.

**Try this:** Pick a model on "Agent", then change "eight" in its system prompt to twelve for a longer piece, or add a total running time it must hit.

data.system: You write shot lists. Give eight numbered shots. Each: framing, subject, camera move, duration in seconds. No dialogue.

workflows.name: Movie Trailer Generator
workflows.description: Type a single logline and get back a cinematic teaser. The Director node writes the storyboard — a screenplay of shots with camera direction and one style bible — Screenplay Shots turns each shot into an image prompt, and the frames are rendered, animated, and cut together. Cost note: each shot runs through Veo 3.1 image-to-video, which is metered per second of generated video and is the most expensive step in the pipeline — a 6-shot trailer makes 6 Veo calls.

data.comment:
# 🎬 Movie Trailer Generator

Type one logline and the canvas builds a cinematic teaser. Use it to pitch a film idea as a short cut of animated shots.

**How it works:** "1️⃣ Logline", "2️⃣ Visual style" and "3️⃣ Shot count" (6) feed "4️⃣ Direct the storyboard", the same Director node the Storyboard editor runs behind its Direct button. It writes the screenplay, camera direction and one style bible. "5️⃣ One prompt per shot" emits one prompt per shot. "6️⃣ Render keyframes" draws each as a 16:9 2K still, and "7️⃣ Animate each keyframe (Veo, metered per second)" turns it into a 4-second 720p clip. "Collect video clips" gathers the clips and "🎬 Final trailer" joins them for "8️⃣ Trailer output". The Director uses Gemini, the keyframes use GPT Image 2 through Kie, and the animation uses Veo 3.1, which is billed per second and costs the most. A 6-shot trailer makes 6 Veo calls.

**Try this:** Set "3️⃣ Shot count" to 3 for a cheaper test run and confirm the trailer has three clips.

workflows.name: Score a Silent Clip
workflows.description: Generate a soundtrack to match your clip. Trim the music to the video length, normalise the volume, and add gentle fades before mixing.

data.comment:
# Score a Silent Clip

Generates a soundtrack that fits your clip and mixes it under the picture. Use it to give a silent product or b-roll shot background music.

**How it works:** "Measure the clip" reads the length of "Clip" and passes it to "Write the score (fal)" as the duration and to "Fit music to the clip" as the trim end. "Write the score (fal)" turns the "Mood" text into music with Stable Audio 2.5. "Fit music to the clip" trims it, "Even out volume" normalizes it, and "Soften the start" (0.3 s) and "Soften the ending" (1 s) add fades. "Mix the soundtrack" lays the music over the video at volume 0.35, and "Scored clip" shows the result. The music step needs a fal key.

**Try this:** Change "Mood" to "slow ambient synth pads, no drums" and raise the volume on "Mix the soundtrack" to 0.6 to hear the music sit louder.
